steps.text: DirectX 12 only, so D3DMetal. The -dx11 launch option crashes the game at start, the game appends its own DirectX 12 flag and Unreal refuses two (measured from the crash context, highball-db#48). The recipe advertises AVX to the game, which turned out unrelated. On macOS 15.7.7 the game reported "Failed to initialize DirectX 12" on D3DMetal after about 30 seconds, cause not measured, not a macOS 26 requirement (CrossOver 26 runs this D3DMetal on macOS 15).

knownIssues.symptom: Crashes at second zero at fixed addresses on any graphics mode when -dx11 is among the Steam launch options (reported on an M4 Max, macOS 15.7.7)
knownIssues.cause: measured from CrashContext.runtime-xml: "-d3d12, -d3d11, -vulkan, and -opengl are mutually exclusive options, but more than one was specified on the command-line", with only -dx11 on the line the process was started with. Inferred, not yet measured: the game appends its own DirectX 12 flag after start, it forces DirectX 12 and WB's FAQ warns DirectX 11 workarounds break launching
knownIssues.fix: do not use -dx11 with this game, on any platform. The DirectX 12 build on D3DMetal is the only path. AVX advertised to the game turned out unrelated

knownIssues.symptom: "Failed to initialize DirectX 12. Graphics drivers may require an update" after about 30 seconds on D3DMetal with AVX on (reported on an M4 Max, macOS 15.7.7)
knownIssues.cause: not measured. Not a macOS 26 requirement, CrossOver 26 ships the same D3DMetal 3.0 on macOS 15 and the game is reported running there
knownIssues.fix: none yet, waiting on the game's log lines from the D3D12 RHI
